rationale.conceptual: The method involves multiple components: tight-binding energy dispersions, Slater integral relations for interactions, derivation of mean-field self-consistency equations for charge imbalance and magnetization, and total energy expressions. While the mean-field approach is standard, correctly implementing the specific relations and handling multiple ferromagnetic states (I/II/III) and the excitonic gap equation requires careful translation of the paper's formalism.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of a single codebase that computes both models and outputs CSV files. There are only 2-3 logical steps (model definition, multi-X-point grid search, single-X-point grid search), all within Python. No data fetching, multi-tool orchestration, or heavy engineering is required.
